# 1 Clement Chapter 58 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 58

**58:1** Let us therefore obey his all-holy and glorious name, and flee from the afore-mentioned threats of Wisdom, that we may be settled upon the most sacred name of his majesty.

**58:2** Receive our counsel, and you shall have no regrets. For as God lives, and as the Lord Jesus Christ lives, and the Holy Spirit — the faith and hope of the elect — so surely shall the one who with humility and constant gentleness, without regret, has fulfilled the ordinances and commandments given by God, be enrolled and kept in the number of those who are saved through Jesus Christ, through whom to him be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
